units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:9">Kel. VIII, 9</cite> <he>כ׳ של סיידין וכ׳</he> the furnace of lime burners, glass-makers and potters.
<cite ref="Sukkah 7b:19">Succ. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>עשויה ככ׳</he> shaped like a furnace (round).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>כִּבְשַׁן האש</he> the heated furnace.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>היוצר … בודק כִּבְשָׁנוֹ</he> when the potter examines a batch of his kiln; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כִּבְשׁוֹנוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 82b:12">B. Kam. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>אין עושין בה כ׳</he> no furnaces were erected in Jerusalem; <cite ref="Chagigah 26a:9">Ḥag. 26ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 96a:1">Zeb. 96ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Zevachim 96a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>נהדרינהו לכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>אהדר׳</he>) let them be put back into the furnaces (to be baked over).

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 1:10">Tosef. B. Bath. I, 10</cite> <he>מרחיקין את הכ׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="K00092"><he>כבשנית</he></cite>, corr. acc.) furnaces must be removed from the town fifty cubits.

Ḥag. 13ᵃ (play on כבשים, Prov. XXVII, 26) א״ת כבשים אלא כְּבוּשִׁים דברים שהם כִּבְשׁוֹנוֹ של עולם וכ׳ Ms. M. read not K’basim but K’bushim, things which are the secret of the world (esoteric doctrines) must be kept under one’s garment (in one’s bosom).
